Name: Specialized Monster Musk
Author: BeardedRascal
Description:
This mod adds 12 new types of [i]Monster Musk[/i] for you to craft.
They are centered around the [i]Monster Eradication Goals[/i] mobs and will help you to complete them faster.
Glow, Duration, and crafting cost ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Recipe_data#Ingredients_and_yield]wiki[/url]) are configurable.

This is my first C# mod, so it's very basic, all it's doing is cloning monsters in place if you have the right buff activated.

Requirements : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
This is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[u]Installation / Usage :
[/u]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Extract the content of this downloaded mod zip file into your [i]Mods[/i] folder.
- Launch the game using SMAPI
- Edit the config.json file or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to configure the mod at your leisure
